name: pnp-powerplatform-prompts-vendor-self-service-portal
title: Vendor Self-Service Portal
shortDescription: Authenticated Power Pages portal for vendors to register, upload compliance documents, track PO and payment status, submit invoices, and receive certification expiry alerts.
longDescription: This Power Pages prompt generates an authenticated B2B procurement portal. Vendors register with company details and tax ID, upload compliance certifications and insurance (with 30-day expiry alerts), view purchase order status, check payment status (Pending, Processing, Paid), and submit invoices. Uses role-based framing and introduces authenticated access and document lifecycle management patterns not present in existing Power Pages samples.

metadata.value: As a procurement manager, I need a secure vendor portal for supplier registration, document upload, PO status tracking, and invoice submission with a dashboard.
